newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - VidaMed approval expected.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - VidaMed approval expected.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist analyst Rob Faulkner expects a U.S. Food and Drug Administration okay of VidaMed's TransUrethral Needle Ablation (TUNA) system by the end of September.
-- In written research, Faulkner said VidaMed met with the FDA on Friday to review labeling claims for TUNA. Indications are that there are "no remaining issues related to clinical data."

-- He added VidaMed will likely not meet Hambrecht's third quarter sales estimate of $1.4 million because it had to stop taking orders for TUNA, after FDA queries, but Faulkner views those questions as an "artifact" and inconsequential to his long-term outlook. He rates the stock a long term buy.
